cards.effect: Survival Adaptation. Choose one hazard when activated: extreme heat, extreme cold, poisonous atmosphere, high altitude/low oxygen, corrosive environment or difficult natural terrain. For 3 rounds you ignore ordinary environmental penalties from that hazard; if it deals acid, cold, fire or poison damage, you instead gain resistance to that one damage type. This grants no immunity and does not protect allies.

source.originalText: Survival Adaptation: Rapidly adapt your body to environmental hazards, gaining temporary resistance to environmental effects.

cards.name: Intimidating Transformation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see you
cards.effect: Intimidating Transformation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would instead be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A target succeeding on the initial save is immune to this use. The transformation does not force surrender or belief changes.

source.originalText: Intimidating Transformation: Undergo a particularly terrifying mutation that can cause enemies to become frightened or even paralyzed with fear.

cards.name: Guardian Tissue
cards.effect: Guardian Tissue. When an adjacent ally would take damage, reduce that ally's incoming damage by one-third rounded down. You take the prevented amount as damage of the same type. This transferred damage cannot be redirected again and cannot trigger another Guardian Tissue. Transferred damage cannot be reduced again, redirected again or generate BT.

source.originalText: Guardian Tissue: When an adjacent ally would take damage, you can absorb 30% of it as a reaction.

cards.name: Protective Mutations
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 5 feet while you have at least one active mutation
cards.effect: Protective Mutations. While at least one mutation is active, each ally other than you within 5 feet reduces the first damage it takes each round by S, minimum 0. Multiple Protective Mutations do not stack. The protection ends immediately when the ally leaves the aura or you have no active mutation.

source.originalText: Protective Mutations: Your mutations generate a 5-foot aura that grants allies +10% damage resistance.

cards.name: Serum Sharing
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally you touch
cards.frequency: At most once per ally per short rest
cards.effect: Serum Sharing. Inject one willing ally with a diluted prepared serum. The ally receives half of each positive numeric benefit of that serum profile, rounded down with minimum 1, for 3 rounds; nonnumeric immunities become advantage on the relevant save instead. The serum activates no mutation in the ally. The ally gains 1 Strain for this pilot and suffers the profile's printed side effect. Your Serum Tolerance does not protect the ally.

source.originalText: Serum Sharing: You can safely inject allies with diluted versions of your serums, granting them 50% of the benefits.

cards.name: Controlled Transformation
cards.effect: Controlled Transformation. You can suppress obvious cosmetic signs of dormant mutations and reduce visible manifestations of active mutations enough to pass as merely scarred or unusually built while fully clothed. You gain advantage on checks to conceal your Warrior mutations from casual visual inspection. This never suppresses mechanical mutation effects, defeats magical detection or conceals transformations whose cards explicitly make you Large, monstrous or otherwise impossible to hide.

source.originalText: Controlled Transformation: Your mutations appear less monstrous and can be partially concealed when necessary.

cards.name: Aegis Incarnate
cards.effect: Final Form – Aegis Incarnate. For 3 rounds you cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone. Whenever an ally within 15 feet takes damage, automatically redirect half that damage rounded down to yourself after the ally's resistance but before its temporary HP; the ally takes the remainder. Redirected damage keeps its type, cannot be reduced again or generate BT, and cannot be redirected again. If taking the redirected damage would kill you outright, the redirection still occurs. This grants no extra Reaction requirement and does not stack with Guardian Tissue on the same damage event.

source.originalText: Final Form – Aegis Incarnate: Transform into a living shield for 3 rounds, becoming immovable and redirecting 50% of all damage dealt to allies within 15 feet to yourself.

cards.name: Bulwark Mutation Tree
cards.effect: Bulwark Mutation Tree. Unlock the Wardborn-specific mutations Spinal Plating, Adrenal Overwatch and Living Cover as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots, require serum activation unless their card says otherwise, and obey all active-mutation, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not automatically equip or activate any of them.

source.originalText: Bulwark Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

cards.name: Mutated Guard
cards.rangeAndTarget: One ally within 10 feet when your turn ends
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Mutated Guard. If you end your turn within 10 feet of at least one ally, choose one such ally. Until the start of your next regular turn it gains +1 on saving throws and reduces the first damage it takes by 1. This benefit does not stack with another Mutated Guard.

source.originalText: Mutated Guard: If you end your turn within 2 tiles of an ally, grant them +1 Save and DR

cards.name: Guardian Pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: One adjacent ally and triggering attacker
cards.effect: Guardian Pulse. Trigger when an adjacent ally is targeted by an attack. You become the target instead; resolve the original attack roll against your AC and defenses. After that attack fully resolves, if the attacker is within your melee reach, make one melee weapon attack against it. This counterattack is a free attack, cannot grant another free attack or Action, and occurs whether the redirected attack hit or missed.

source.originalText: Guardian Pulse: 1/rest, redirect an attack from an adjacent ally to yourself and immediately counterstrike

cards.name: Warding Mutation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; protects one ally within 10 feet at a time
cards.effect: Warding Mutation. Grow temporary protective plates for 3 rounds. At the start of each of your turns choose one ally within 10 feet. Until the start of your next turn, the first time that ally takes damage reduce it by S+M, minimum 0. The prevented damage is simply negated rather than transferred. This is a temporary transformation, not an equipped mutation, and cannot stack with itself.

source.originalText: Warding Mutation: Develop protective growths that can absorb damage directed at allies.

cards.name: Stabilizing Injection
cards.frequency: At most once per target per long rest
cards.effect: Stabilizing Injection. The target regains 2d8 + M HP and may end one of Poisoned, Frightened or Staggered. If Diseased, it may immediately repeat one saving throw the disease normally permits. This removes no Wounds, cannot restore the dead and does not activate a mutation or apply the consumed serum's normal profile.

source.originalText: Stabilizing Injection: Use your serum knowledge to create a stabilizing agent that can heal and remove negative status effects.

cards.name: Environmental Adaptation
cards.duration: Until 10 minutes after leaving the environment
cards.effect: Environmental Adaptation. After 1 uninterrupted minute exposed to extreme heat, extreme cold, high altitude/low oxygen, poisonous atmosphere or another Director-defined natural environmental hazard, adapt to it. Ignore ordinary environmental penalties from that hazard and gain advantage on saves against it. Adapting to a new environment replaces the previous adaptation. This does not grant damage immunity.

source.originalText: Environmental Adaptation: Your body automatically begins adapting to extreme environments after 1 minute of exposure.

cards.name: Regenerative Mutation
cards.cost: Spend healing amount from Mutation Recovery Reserve
cards.duration: While at least one mutation is active in a real encounter
cards.frequency: Once at the start of each regular turn
cards.effect: Regenerative Mutation. At the start of your regular turn during a real encounter, if at least one mutation is active and you are below maximum HP, regain S+M HP. This regeneration functions only during a real encounter, cannot restore the dead or remove Wounds, and cannot be increased by remaining in initiative without meaningful opposition. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal only up to remaining reserve.

source.originalText: Regenerative Mutation: Heal 5% of your maximum health each round while at least one mutation is active.

cards.name: Serum Recycling
cards.rangeAndTarget: One serum dose you are consuming
cards.effect: Serum Recycling. Whenever you would consume a prepared serum dose, roll a d20. On 17-20, the dose is not consumed after its effects resolve. Strain and all other costs still apply. A preserved dose remains in its original prepared profile and cannot increase your serum reserve above its normal capacity.

source.originalText: Serum Recycling: 20% chance to not consume a serum when activating a mutation.

cards.name: Damage Memory
cards.duration: Until completion of a short or long rest
cards.frequency: Tracks one damage type at a time
cards.effect: Damage Memory. When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder damage, begin or continue remembering that type. The first subsequent damage event of the same type is reduced by 1, the next by 2 and later events by 3, maximum DR 3. Taking a different listed type replaces the remembered type and resets the progression. Resistance applies separately and never upgrades this feature to immunity.

source.originalText: Damage Memory: After taking a specific damage type, gain increasing resistance to it with each subsequent hit.

cards.name: Adaptive Perfection
cards.effect: Final Form – Adaptive Perfection. Choose up to three damage types from acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder that have actually damaged you since your last long rest, plus one environmental hazard you personally experienced during that period. For 3 rounds you are immune to the chosen damage types and ignore ordinary penalties from the chosen hazard. You cannot choose a type or hazard you did not actually encounter, and multiple immunity sources do not stack.

source.originalText: Final Form – Adaptive Perfection: For 3 rounds, gain immunity to the damage types and environmental effects you've been exposed to during the current day.

cards.name: Gore Mutation Tree
cards.effect: Gore Mutation Tree. Unlock the Ironskin-specific mutations Gore Maw, Reinforced Joints and Shard Skin as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots and obey serum activation, concurrency, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card equips or activates none of them automatically.

source.originalText: Gore Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

cards.name: Stack Overflow
cards.effect: Stack Overflow. Increase your stored BT cap from 3 to 4. Brutal Fortitude remains capped at DR 3. At BT 4 you count as Transcendent for features that explicitly reference stored BT 4, but reaching BT 4 does not itself activate every mutation unless the common Transcendent state says so.

source.originalText: Stack Overflow: Can hold up to 4 BT stacks instead of 3

cards.name: Auto-Rupture
cards.effect: Auto-Rupture. When your stored BT first reaches its current maximum during a round, each enemy within 5 feet makes a Strength save. On failure it falls Prone. The shockwave deals no damage, spends no BT and cannot retrigger from remaining at maximum BT; you must fall below the cap and later reach it again.

source.originalText: Auto-Rupture: If you reach max BT, release a shockwave: all adjacent enemies must STR save or fall prone

cards.name: Adaptive Mutation
cards.effect: Adaptive Mutation. Trigger when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or another Director-approved environmental damage type, or when an environmental hazard forces you to make a saving throw. Gain resistance to that damage type or advantage on saves against that specific hazard for 3 rounds. Choose one if both apply. This is a temporary transformation and consumes no mutation slot or serum.

source.originalText: Adaptive Mutation: Rapidly evolve your body to counter a specific threat or environmental hazard.

cards.name: Cellular Reconstruction
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn, then instantaneous recovery
cards.effect: Cellular Reconstruction. Enter stasis until the start of your next regular turn: your Speed becomes 0, you cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions, and attacks against you have advantage. At the start of your next turn regain 3d8 + M HP and end Poisoned plus one mundane or magical disease that does not explicitly require a special cure. This removes no Wounds and cannot function while dead.

source.originalText: Cellular Reconstruction: Enter a brief stasis where your body rapidly heals and purges toxins or diseases.

cards.name: Horrific Appearance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies within 15 feet that can see you
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.frequency: At most once per target per round
cards.effect: Horrific Appearance. Whenever you activate a mutation, each qualifying enemy within 15 feet makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. A creature already Frightened by this feature is not forced to save again until that instance ends. This never forces surrender or changes beliefs.

source.originalText: Horrific Appearance: Enemies who see you activate a mutation must make a fear save or be frightened for 1 round.

cards.name: Infectious Mutation
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your weapon or natural attack
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Infectious Mutation. After you hit a creature, roll a d10. On a 10, painful temporary growths erupt: the target takes S psychic damage and has -1 on its next attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn, whichever occurs first. This is not a permanent mutation, disease or body alteration and cannot spread or reproduce.

source.originalText: Infectious Mutation: Your attacks have a 10% chance to cause minor, painful mutations in your targets.

cards.name: Serum Toxicity
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and creatures exposed to your serum or blood
cards.effect: Serum Toxicity. A creature other than you that is directly injected with one of your prepared serum doses takes S d6 poison damage after the injection unless a feature expressly makes that serum safe; this damage does not create BT. Additionally, once per round when a creature within 5 feet deals piercing or slashing melee damage to you, it takes S acid damage from your blood. The retaliation cannot recursively trigger itself.

source.originalText: Serum Toxicity: Your serums become poisonous to others; your blood deals acid damage to those who wound you.

cards.name: Pain Empowerment
cards.effect: Pain Empowerment. For every full 10% of your maximum HP currently missing, add +1 damage to one weapon or natural-weapon damage roll on each of your turns, maximum +5. Determine the bonus immediately before the chosen damage roll. Healing can reduce the bonus during the encounter. It does not increase mutation retaliation, ongoing damage or area effects.

source.originalText: Pain Empowerment: Gain +5% damage for each 10% of health you are missing.

cards.name: Abomination Ascendant
cards.effect: Final Form – Abomination Ascendant. For 3 rounds your melee reach increases by 5 feet, your Speed increases by 10 feet and you gain a natural Claw attack dealing 2d8 + M slashing damage. At the start of each enemy's turn within 30 feet that can see you, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of that turn. The hard-control guard still applies to any other denial effect you use. This transformation grants no free attacks or additional Actions.

source.originalText: Final Form – Abomination Ascendant: Transform into a nightmarish creature for 3 rounds, gaining terrifying new attacks and abilities while causing fear in a 30-foot radius.

cards.name: Aberrant Mutation Tree
cards.effect: Aberrant Mutation Tree. Unlock the Dreadspawn-specific mutations Whip-Tendon Limbs, Soul Spike Carapace and Hemophage Core as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots and obey serum activation, concurrency, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not equip or activate any of them.

source.originalText: Aberrant Mutation Tree: Unlocks:

cards.name: Terror Radius
cards.effect: Terror Radius. For 3 rounds, at the start of each enemy's turn within 15 feet it makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers -1 AC and -1 on morale checks until the start of its next turn. Each turn grants a new save. The effect does not stack with itself and does not reduce saving throws or attack rolls.

source.originalText: Terror Radius: Enemies within 3 tiles at start of turn must save or suffer –1 morale and –1 AC

cards.name: Apex Aberration (1/day)
cards.effect: Apex Aberration. For 2 rounds increase Strength by 4, maximum 24 from this feature. You are immune to the effects and damage of hostile rank-3-or-lower spells, but not higher-rank spells, non-spell magical abilities or friendly spells you choose to accept. Whenever your weapon or natural attack hits, the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the cap.

source.originalText: Apex Aberration (1/day): You transform for 2 rounds:

cards.name: Horrific Mutation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see or hear you
cards.effect: Horrific Mutation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A successful initial save grants immunity to this use. This transformation does not compel surrender or obedience.

source.originalText: Horrific Mutation: Undergo a particularly disturbing transformation designed to terrify and demoralize enemies.

cards.name: Toxic Secretion
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; your melee weapon and natural attacks
cards.effect: Toxic Secretion. For 3 rounds, once on each of your turns when a melee weapon or natural attack hits, add S d4 poison damage. The target then makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Repeated applications refresh rather than stack. Poison immunity prevents both the condition and poison damage as normal.

source.originalText: Toxic Secretion: Develop glands that secrete powerful toxins, allowing you to poison enemies with your attacks.

cards.name: Mutation Slot I
cards.effect: Gain one mutation slot. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in it. The equipped mutation remains dormant until activated unless its own text says otherwise.

source.originalText: | 1 | Mutation Slot I (choose 1), Brutality Threshold (BT) tracker |

cards.name: Brutality Threshold Tracker
cards.effect: Track Brutality Progress and BT using the common Warrior engine. Default BT cap is 3. Encounter end resets both to 0.

source.originalText: | 1 | Mutation Slot I (choose 1), Brutality Threshold (BT) tracker |

cards.name: Mutagen Injection
cards.effect: Choose Power or Guard. Power grants +2 Strength, maximum 22 from this feature. Guard grants +2 AC. This emergency mutagen does not consume a prepared serum dose and does not activate a mutation.

source.originalText: | 2 | Mutagen Injection (1/rest: +2 STR or +2 AC for 3 rounds) |

cards.name: Mutation Slot II
cards.effect: Gain a second mutation slot. This does not by itself raise the active-mutation concurrency limit.

source.originalText: | 5 | Mutation Slot II unlocked |

cards.name: Bone Hardened
cards.effect: While you are not Staggered, reduce physical weapon damage you take by 1 after resistance and before temporary HP.

source.originalText: | 6 | Bone Hardened: DR +1 while not staggered |

cards.name: Serum Overclock
cards.effect: Inject two different prepared serum profiles simultaneously and activate up to two eligible equipped mutations, respecting your active-mutation limit. Resolve both profile effects; same-stat bonuses use the stronger. Overclock is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 9, Strain 1 or lower, two prepared serum doses

source.originalText: | 9 | Serum Overclock: Inject 2 serums at once |

cards.name: Mutation Slot III
cards.effect: Gain a third mutation slot. Ordinary active-mutation concurrency remains governed by Mutation Efficiency and explicit exceptions.

source.originalText: | 13 | Mutation Slot III unlocked |

cards.name: Brutal Adaptation
cards.effect: After each completed short or long rest choose one equipped mutation. Gain one of its passive numeric benefits at half value rounded down, minimum 1 where applicable, even while that mutation is dormant. Damage dice, control, immunity, regeneration and trigger effects cannot be selected.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 15, at least one equipped mutation

source.originalText: | 15 | Brutal Adaptation – Gain passive bonus from a mutation |

cards.name: Reflexive Mutation
cards.effect: When you take damage or fail a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution save, inject one prepared serum and activate one eligible equipped mutation before subsequent effects from the triggering event resolve. It cannot retroactively undo damage or a failed save.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 17, legal serum dose and Strain below 3

source.originalText: | 17 | Reflexive Mutation – Once per round, mutate reactively |

cards.name: Apex Form
cards.effect: Gain mutation slot IV permanently. When Apex Form activates, all equipped mutations become active for 3 rounds without consuming serum doses and ignore the normal active-mutation concurrency limit. Serum-profile effects are not granted. When the form ends, choose active mutations up to your normal limit; all others become dormant.

source.originalText: | 20 | Apex Form – Gain a permanent 4th mutation & unleash once/encounter ultimate form |

cards.name: Awakened
cards.effect: Once per encounter, when a serum activation would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This represents reduced activation cost; it cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain.

source.originalText: | Awakened | Deal 25% of max HP as damage | Mutations cost 10% less to activate |

cards.name: Primed
cards.effect: Enhance one active mutation's numeric benefit for the turn: +1 to one AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage bonus; +5 feet to one movement/reach bonus; or +1 damage/healing to one mutation-generated roll. Primed never increases duration, targets, immunity or resource generation.

source.originalText: | Primed | Deal 50% of max HP as damage | Active mutations gain +25% effectiveness |

cards.name: Unleashed
cards.effect: You satisfy the Brutality Threshold requirement for Brutality Unleashed and other features explicitly requiring the Unleashed state.

source.originalText: | Unleashed | Deal 75% of max HP as damage | Unlock Brutality Unleashed ability |

cards.name: Transcendent
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: At Warrior 12+, the first time this encounter you cross 100% Brutality Progress or reach stored BT 4, activate all equipped mutations until start of your next regular turn. No serum profile or immediate healing trigger is granted. This is one total pulse, never a permanent BT 4 concurrency increase. At end choose active mutations up to normal limit, with their original remaining durations; others become dormant.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 12; 100% Brutality Progress or BT 4 with raised cap; new explicit level gate

source.originalText: | Transcendent | Deal 100% of max HP as damage | All mutations active simultaneously for 1 round |

cards.name: Overdrive
cards.effect: Gain +2 to Strength or Dexterity, chosen on preparation, and +10 feet Speed. Side effect: -1 AC for the duration. Serum Tolerance suppresses the side effect but not Strain.

source.originalText: | Overdrive | +2 STR/DEX | +10% Speed | 3 rounds | -10% Defense |

cards.name: Stonecore
cards.effect: Gain +2 AC and immunity to forced movement or knockback from creatures no more than one size larger. Side effect: Speed -10 feet. Serum Tolerance suppresses the Speed penalty.

source.originalText: | Stonecore | +2 AC | Immunity to knockback | 3 rounds | -15% Speed |

cards.name: Sanguine Surge
cards.frequency: Per prepared dose; same creature cannot receive its healing more than once per short rest
cards.effect: On injection regain 2d6 HP and gain +10 feet Speed for 3 rounds. Side effect: when the profile ends gain 1 additional Strain, maximum 3. Serum Tolerance suppresses that ending side effect. This healing removes no Wounds and cannot operate on a dead creature.

source.originalText: | Sanguine Surge | Heal 2d6 | +10 ft speed | 3 rounds | Increased Hunger |

cards.name: Mind Shock
cards.effect: Gain +2 on saving throws against spells. Once during the duration gain one additional Reaction usable only for movement, defense, Counterspell-like disruption already possessed or another non-attack reaction; it cannot make an attack. Side effect: -1 on Perception checks for the duration. Serum Tolerance suppresses that penalty.

source.originalText: | Mind Shock | +2 Save vs spells | +1 reaction use this turn | 3 rounds | Minor Hallucinations |

cards.name: Chromatic Flux
cards.effect: Gain advantage on Stealth checks when at least lightly obscured and choose extreme heat or extreme cold; you ignore ordinary environmental penalties from that choice during the duration. Side effect: vivid discoloration gives disadvantage on attempts to pass as physically unaltered. Serum Tolerance suppresses that social side effect.

source.originalText: | Chromatic Flux | Adaptive Camouflage | Environmental Adaptation | 3 rounds | Skin Discoloration |

cards.name: Berserker Brew
cards.effect: You are immune to Frightened and once on each of your turns add 2 S damage to one melee weapon or natural-weapon hit. Side effect: -1 AC and you cannot voluntarily take Dodge or Disengage. Serum Tolerance suppresses the side effect but not the once-per-turn damage cap.

source.originalText: | Berserker Brew | +40% Damage | Fear Immunity | 3 rounds | Temporary Madness |

cards.name: Ironhide Graft
cards.effect: Gain +2 AC against melee attack rolls and reduce the first physical weapon damage you take each round by 1.

source.originalText: | Ironhide Graft | +2 AC vs melee, +1 DR |

cards.name: Bloodthick Node
cards.duration: While active during a real encounter
cards.frequency: Once at start of each regular turn
cards.effect: Regain HP equal to current BT, maximum 3 HP per turn or 4 with Stack Overflow. No healing occurs outside a real encounter and it removes no Wounds. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: | Bloodthick Node | Heal 1 HP per BT stack each round |

cards.name: Spinal Buffer
cards.effect: Gain +1 on saving throws against being knocked Prone, Stunned or forcibly moved. If an effect uses an ability check rather than a save, add +1 to that check instead.

source.originalText: | Spinal Buffer | +1 Save vs knockback, stuns, and forced movement |

cards.name: Flesh Warden
cards.effect: Increase maximum HP by 2 per Warrior level while equipped. Equipping raises maximum only, never current HP. Unequipping clamps current HP to the reduced maximum if necessary; it does not subtract another amount from current HP. Repeated swaps cannot heal.

source.originalText: | Flesh Warden | +2 HP per level |

cards.name: Plated Shoulder
cards.effect: While adjacent to substantial terrain, a wall or a willing ally of your size or larger, you gain half cover against ranged attacks.

source.originalText: | Plated Shoulder | Gain half cover while standing adjacent to terrain or ally |

cards.name: Redundant Organs
cards.effect: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP instead.

source.originalText: | Redundant Organs | First time you'd fall to 0 HP, stay at 1 (1/long rest) |

cards.name: Rapid Coagulation
cards.duration: While active during a real encounter
cards.effect: If you did not move during your previous turn, regain 2 HP at the start of your current turn. This does not function outside a real encounter. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: | Rapid Coagulation | Gain Regeneration 2 if you haven't moved this round |

cards.name: Ossified Core
cards.effect: Critical hits against you do not add extra critical damage dice. Additionally reduce piercing damage you take by 2 after resistance.

source.originalText: | Ossified Core | Immune to crit damage; take 2 less damage from piercing attacks |

cards.name: Adrenal Floodgate
cards.effect: When you first fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, regain 2d8 HP and end either Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered on yourself.

source.originalText: | Adrenal Floodgate | Once per encounter, heal 2d8 HP and remove 1 condition when you drop below 25% HP |

cards.name: Thickened Bone Weave
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: When you activate a serum or gain at least 1 BT, gain DR 2 against physical weapon damage until the end of your next regular turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: | Thickened Bone Weave | +2 DR for 2 rounds after using a serum or gaining a BT stack |

cards.name: Mythic Carapace
cards.duration: Until encounter ends, mutation ends or you fall below one-quarter maximum HP
cards.effect: Gain DR 3 against all damage and immunity to Bleed, Poisoned and Burn-style ongoing fire effects. Once per encounter when one hit deals more than 20 actual damage after mitigation, gain 1 BT and refresh the remaining duration of your other active mutations to 3 rounds. It grants no serum-profile refresh.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Vital; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Mythic Carapace | While this is active:
- +3 DR flat
- Immune to Bleed, Poison, and Burn
- Once per combat, when you're struck for more than 20 damage: immediately gain +1 BT and refresh all active mutations
- Lasts until the end of combat or you fall below 25% HP |

cards.name: Brute Knuckles
cards.effect: Your unarmed strike damage die becomes 1d10. On an unarmed critical hit, the target makes a Strength save; on failure it drops one non-attuned held item of its choice.

source.originalText: | Brute Knuckles | Unarmed strikes deal 1d10 and apply Disarm on crit |

cards.name: Splinter Bone Fangs
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
cards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
cards.effect: A melee critical applies Bleed. The target takes 1d4 physical damage at the start of each of its next 2 turns. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

source.originalText: | Splinter Bone Fangs | Melee crits cause 1d4 bleed for 2 rounds |

cards.name: Lashing Ligaments
cards.effect: For one melee attack on your turn, increase your reach by 5 feet. Using the extended reach does not itself provoke opportunity attacks.

source.originalText: | Lashing Ligaments | Gain +5 ft melee reach once per turn (doesn't provoke AoO) |

cards.name: Jaw Clench Node
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: After you score a critical hit, gain +1 on attack rolls and +2 on Intimidation checks until the end of your next regular turn.

source.originalText: | Jaw Clench Node | Gain +1 to hit and +2 to Intimidation for 1 round after crit |

cards.name: Shoulder Spike Cluster
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature grappling you or grappled by you
cards.effect: When a grapple is established or maintained against you, or you successfully establish a grapple, the other creature takes 1d6 piercing damage.

source.originalText: | Shoulder Spike Cluster | When grappling or being grappled, attacker takes 1d6 damage |

cards.name: Shock Muscle Weave
cards.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee weapon attack. This additional attack is not a new Action and cannot itself grant another attack. It does not apply to card techniques unless they explicitly use the ordinary Attack action.

source.originalText: | Shock Muscle Weave | Gain +1 attack per turn (stacks with extra attacks, but only melee) |

cards.name: Razorbone Growths
cards.effect: Your melee attacks ignore 1 point of flat DR. Resistance and immunity are unaffected.

source.originalText: | Razorbone Growths | All melee attacks ignore 1 point of DR |

cards.name: Echo Knuckles
cards.effect: After you hit with a melee attack, make one offhand slam against the same target using your Warrior technique attack. On hit deal 1d8+M bludgeoning damage. This is a free attack, cannot trigger Echo Knuckles again and cannot grant another free attack.

source.originalText: | Echo Knuckles | Once per round, after hitting, make a free offhand slam (1d8) |

cards.name: Adrenal Backlash Core
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: After you take damage, empower your next melee hit before the end of your next regular turn to deal +2d6 damage of the weapon's normal type. A new trigger refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: | Adrenal Backlash Core | When you take damage, your next melee hit deals +2d6 |

cards.name: Warpgrip Talons
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
cards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
cards.effect: A melee critical applies Weakened for 2 rounds. While Weakened, the target deals 1 less damage with each weapon or natural-weapon hit, minimum 0. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

source.originalText: | Warpgrip Talons | Melee attacks apply Weakened on crit (–1 damage from target for 2 rounds) |

cards.name: Butcherform Chassis
cards.duration: 3 rounds or until below one-quarter maximum HP
cards.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee attack beyond other Extra Attack effects, respecting the one-additional-full-Action guard because this is part of the same Action. Your melee criticals add one extra weapon damage die beyond normal critical dice, not triple total damage. Once per round when you personally kill a meaningful hostile with a melee attack, restore one consumed prepared serum dose, never above reserve capacity.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Combat; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Butcherform Chassis | While active:
- Gain +2 attacks per round
- Crits deal triple damage
- Melee kills instantly refresh 1 serum or 1 mutation use
- Lasts for 3 rounds or until you're below 25% HP |

cards.name: Ink-Slick Glands
cards.effect: Create opaque black mist. Creatures outside the cloud cannot see through it; ranged attacks passing through the cloud have disadvantage. Wind or an equivalent dispersal effect may end it early.

source.originalText: | Ink-Slick Glands | Once per rest, exude a cloud of black mist (3x3, blocks LoS, causes Disadvantage on ranged attacks) |

cards.name: Pulsing Vein Spiral
cards.effect: Gain +2 on Intimidation checks. Enemies within 5 feet take -1 on morale checks or the campaign's equivalent morale roll; this does not alter attack rolls or saving throws.

source.originalText: | Pulsing Vein Spiral | Gain +2 to Intimidation and cause –1 morale on adjacent enemies |

cards.name: Tremor Claws
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
cards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
cards.effect: After a melee critical, the target makes a Strength save. On failure it falls Prone.

source.originalText: | Tremor Claws | Your melee crits force target to make STR save or fall prone |

cards.name: Rib Lash Tendrils
cards.effect: When a creature damages you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 psychic damage. This retaliation cannot trigger itself or other retaliation loops.

source.originalText: | Rib Lash Tendrils | When you are hit in melee, deal 1d4 retaliatory psychic damage |

cards.name: Bone Lure Growth
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it must use up to 15 feet of its available movement to move toward you by the safest path. This movement cannot force it into obviously lethal terrain and never consumes its Action.

source.originalText: | Bone Lure Growth | Once per encounter, force 1 enemy within 4 tiles to move toward you (WIS save negates) |

cards.name: Throat Split Maw
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: You gain a bite attack dealing 1d8+M piercing damage. When the bite hits a creature capable of casting spells, it makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Silenced until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: | Throat Split Maw | Your bite attack silences casters for 1 round on hit |

cards.name: Viral Core Sacs
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: When you activate a serum, enemies within 10 feet make Constitution saves. On failure they have disadvantage on their next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn.

source.originalText: | Viral Core Sacs | When using a serum, release a 2x2 AoE that causes Disadvantage on saves for 1 round |

cards.name: Scythebone Spikes
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your unarmed strike target and one different adjacent creature
cards.effect: When an unarmed strike hits, choose one different enemy within 5 feet of the original target. If the same attack roll would hit that enemy's AC, it takes damage equal to the unarmed strike's base damage die without modifiers. This cleave is not another attack and triggers no on-hit effects.

source.originalText: | Scythebone Spikes | Your unarmed strikes gain cleave (hit 2 adjacent targets) |

cards.name: Carrion Signal Gland
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature that hits you in melee
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: The attacker makes a Wisdom save. On failure it becomes Shaken, taking -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: | Carrion Signal Gland | Enemies who hit you in melee must make WIS save or become Shaken |

cards.name: Wailing Eye Cluster
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Enemies make Wisdom saves. On failure they become Disoriented: at the start of their next turn they cannot take Reactions and their first 5 feet of movement must be in a random legal horizontal direction determined by the Director. They otherwise keep their normal Action and movement.

source.originalText: | Wailing Eye Cluster | As a bonus action 1/rest, emit a psychic scream: enemies within 3 tiles must save or become Disoriented (random movement) |

cards.name: Voidbirth Shell
cards.effect: You may move through enemy spaces and nonmagical difficult terrain without extra cost but cannot end inside a creature or solid object. Enemies within 15 feet take -1 on attack rolls and morale. At the end of each of your turns create one 1-HP clone in an adjacent legal space, maximum 2 clones. A clone cannot attack or block movement; when destroyed it explodes, creatures within 5 feet make Dexterity saves taking 2d6 psychic on failure or half on success. Clones grant no resources, corpses, XP or BT.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Aberrant; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Voidbirth Shell | While active:
- Gain Ethereal Movement (ignore terrain, move through enemies)
- Enemies within 3 tiles have –2 morale and suffer Weakened
- Each turn, summon 1 temporary clone (1 HP, explodes on death for 2d6 psychic)
- Lasts 3 rounds or until all clones are expended |

cards.name: Spinal Plating
cards.effect: Reduce damage you take from area effects by 2 after resistance.

source.originalText: Spinal Plating (+2 DR vs AoE)

cards.name: Adrenal Overwatch
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within weapon reach that damages an ally within 5 feet of you
cards.effect: Make one melee weapon attack against the triggering enemy. This free attack cannot grant another free attack or additional Action.

source.originalText: Adrenal Overwatch (gain reaction attack when ally hit)

cards.name: Living Cover
cards.effect: Adjacent allies gain +2 AC against ranged attacks while you are conscious and not Prone. This does not stack with another Living Cover.

source.originalText: Living Cover (adjacent allies gain +2 AC)

cards.name: Gore Maw
cards.effect: Gain a bite attack dealing 1d8+M piercing. On hit once per turn, the target takes 1d4 Bleed damage at the start of its next 2 turns. Reapplication refreshes.

source.originalText: Gore Maw (bite attack, 1d8 + bleed)

cards.name: Reinforced Joints
cards.effect: You are immune to being knocked Prone by creatures no more than one size larger. Effects from larger creatures instead grant advantage on your save against being knocked Prone.

source.originalText: Reinforced Joints (immune to prone)

cards.name: Shard Skin
cards.effect: When a creature damages you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 piercing damage. This retaliation cannot trigger another retaliation.

source.originalText: Shard Skin (1d4 damage to melee attackers)

cards.name: Whip-Tendon Limbs
cards.effect: Increase melee reach by 5 feet. Once per turn after a melee hit against a creature no more than one size larger, it makes a Strength save; on failure pull it up to 5 feet toward you.

source.originalText: Whip-Tendon Limbs (reach + pull effect)

cards.name: Soul Spike Carapace
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies within 10 feet after your melee critical
cards.duration: Instantaneous; fear until end next turn
cards.effect: When you score a melee critical, gain 1 BT, then enemies of your choice within 10 feet make Wisdom saves. Failure Frightens them until the end of their next turn. The BT gain cannot exceed your cap.

source.originalText: Soul Spike Carapace (crit = +1 BT and fear within 2 tiles)

cards.name: Hemophage Core
cards.effect: When you personally reduce a meaningful hostile creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, regain 2d6 HP. Summoned, trivial, friendly or repeatedly revived creatures cannot trigger this healing. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: Hemophage Core (heal on kill; absorb 2d6 HP)

cards.name: Bio-Stabilizer
cards.effect: While at least two mutations are active, Bloodthick Node heals 1 additional HP on each of its valid encounter-only regeneration pulses.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 4; Bloodthick Node equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Bio-Stabilizer | Bloodthick Node | +1 regen while under the effect of 2+ mutations |

cards.name: Juggernaut's Core
cards.effect: While Ossified Core is active, reduce extra damage explicitly granted by Sneak Attack or equivalent precision-damage features by half, rounded down. Ordinary weapon damage is unaffected.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Ossified Core equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Juggernaut's Core | Ossified Core | If you are immune to crits, gain resistance to sneak attack damage |

cards.name: Living Fortress
cards.frequency: While at least three Vital mutations are active
cards.effect: You cannot grant advantage to an enemy solely because it is flanking you. Other sources of advantage still apply.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; three Vital mutations equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Living Fortress | 3 Vital Mutations active | Gain immunity to flanking |

cards.name: Evolution Under Fire
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Warrior ability with positive recharge
cards.effect: When one damage event deals more than 15 actual damage to you, reduce one positive Warrior round-recharge counter by 1, minimum 0, subject to the universal reset/shortening cap.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 16; any Apex mutation equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Evolution Under Fire | Any Apex Mutation | Whenever you take >15 damage from a single hit, reduce cooldowns by 1 round |

cards.name: Kill-Chain Adaptation
cards.duration: Until end of next regular turn
cards.effect: After you personally reduce a meaningful hostile creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, gain +10 feet Speed and +1 on your next melee attack roll before the end of your next regular turn.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 4; two Combat mutations equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Kill-Chain Adaptation | 2 Combat Mutations | After a melee kill, gain +10 ft movement and +1 to hit |

cards.name: Backlash Engine
cards.effect: While Adrenal Backlash Core is active, the first time each round you take actual damage, gain 1 BT, never above the current cap.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Adrenal Backlash Core equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Backlash Engine | Adrenal Backlash Core | Each time you're hit while mutated, gain +1 BT |

cards.name: Eviscerator Protocol
cards.frequency: When Echo Knuckles hits, once per round
cards.effect: Choose Bleed or Weakened. Bleed deals 1d4 damage at the start of the target's next 2 turns. Weakened causes -1 damage on weapon and natural-weapon hits for 2 rounds. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Echo Knuckles and Warpgrip Talons equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Eviscerator Protocol | Echo Knuckles + Talons | Free offhand hits now apply Bleed or Weakened (player choice) |

cards.name: Hypermutation Spike
cards.effect: When Butcherform Chassis activates, extend its maximum duration from 3 rounds to 5. During that activation you are immune to Stunned and your Speed cannot be reduced below half its normal value.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 16; Butcherform Chassis equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Hypermutation Spike | Butcherform Chassis (Apex) | Once per long rest, extend Butcherform to 5 rounds and become immune to stun/slow during duration |

cards.name: Distorted Dominance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature failing a save against your Aberrant mutation
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: When a creature fails a save against your Aberrant mutation, it loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. This provisional normalization replaces the source's undefined loss of an action and does not fully deny the target's turn.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 4; any Aberrant mutation equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Distorted Dominance | Any Aberrant Mutation | Enemies who fail saves vs your effects also lose 1 action |

cards.name: Terror Engine
cards.effect: While at least two hostile creatures within 30 feet are currently Shaken, Frightened or Disoriented by your Warrior features, reduce the first damage you take each round by 2.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Carrion Signal Gland equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Terror Engine | Carrion Signal Gland | If 2+ enemies are Shaken or Disoriented, gain +2 DR |

cards.name: Born to Horrify
cards.frequency: Once per regular turn while an Apex mutation is active
cards.effect: When you fail a saving throw while an Apex mutation is active, reroll it and use the new result. This can occur at most once on each of your regular turns, not once per enemy turn.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 16; any Apex mutation equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Born to Horrify | Any Apex Mutation | While your Apex mutation is active, you may reroll 1 save per turn |

cards.name: Synaptic Rot
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within 15 feet failing a Wisdom or Intelligence save against your Warrior feature
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: When the target fails the qualifying save, it is Silenced until the end of its next turn. This does not prevent non-spell abilities.
cards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Wailing Eye Cluster or Viral Core Sacs equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Synaptic Rot | Wailing Eye or Viral Core | If an enemy fails a WIS or INT save near you, they cannot cast spells next round |
